title: 中国菜的绝活②过桥米线·不冒热气却烫熟生肉 | Signature Skill P2 · Crossing-Bridge Noodles 🍜
description:
过桥米线，你会先下肉，还是先下米线？ / Meat first, or rice noodles first?

第②集·烫 —— 「中国菜的绝活」系列。一碗看着不冒热气的汤，却能把生肉片烫熟。
P2 · The Scald — from the series The Signature Skill. A bowl of soup that shows no steam, yet cooks raw meat.

秘密在汤面那层厚厚的鸡油——它像盖子一样封住热气，让汤心保持在接近沸腾的温度，表面却不冒烟。吃法讲顺序：先把切得极薄的生肉片推进汤里，几秒就烫白；再下配菜，最后放米线。这碗相传发源于云南蒙自，已有三百余年，位列云南十大名吃之首；传说是贤惠的妻子送饭过桥，发现鸡油能保温，故名「过桥」。
The secret is the thick layer of chicken fat on top — it seals in the heat like a lid, keeping the broth near boiling while the surface shows no steam. Order matters: slide in the paper-thin raw meat first (white in seconds), then greens, then the rice noodles last. The dish is said to come from Mengzi, Yunnan, with 300+ years of history and pride of place among Yunnan's famous foods. Legend credits a devoted wife who carried meals across a bridge and found that chicken fat kept the soup hot — hence 「crossing the bridge」.
